the population pharmacokinetics of cefepimes are not significantly different between patients with ventilator associated pneumonia and patients who are critically ill.

cefepime 2 g every eight hours (three hour infusion) is an appropriate dose regimen in patients with ventilator associated pneumonia (VAP) who have creatinine clearances of greater than 60 ml/min.

cefepime is an appropriate agent for the treatment of critically ill patients with ventilator associated pneumonia (VAP) and that our pharmacokinetic model is a valuable tool to predict the drug’s concentrations in these patients.
